reason: The agent accepted and booked a party of ten, but bookings are only for 1 to 8 guests and larger parties must be referred elsewhere.
name: Party of ten booking

spec.goal: Book a table for ten people today at five in the afternoon.
spec.behavior: You are warm and casual. Give the party size and preferred time in your first message, then give your name when asked. If they read back the details and ask to book it, say yes. Once they say the table is booked, thank them and end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Tables are for 1 to 8 guests. Parties of more than 8 must be referred to the events team.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says they cannot book a table for ten people and instead refers the caller to the events team.
